theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $x$ be an integer list and let $i,i\prime<3|x|$ and $j,j\prime$ be below the complete global-key count for local parameters $h,J$. If the two physical index pairs decode to the same original wanted label, then $$i=i\prime\quad\text{and}\quad j=j\prime.$$

Transfers duplicate-freeness of physical pairs to distinct combinatorial labels. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
